text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Daitaku Helios hyped the 
vibe up to the absolute max.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when those party-filled days had 
settled down a bit—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...So that's why~ I wanna add you to our 
class too, Trai-pi!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just vibes☆ It's way more fun together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainy, you totally bombed at the 
convenience store checkout the other day, 
didn't you? Shouldn't you just, like, redo 
it normally?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's the spirit! Trainer-pi, let's 
Aoharu here we go☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, having your Trainer be your 
classmate is a bit much, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's totally a yes in my book! 
Should we go ask the teacher?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Palmer seems a whole lot more cheerful 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you've been influenced by 
Helios-chan way too much.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's the plan! Let's go storm 
Teach!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy~! Gotta buy the uniform tooâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby! What's up!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you came to see me!? Love ya so 
much~☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but I have no 
business with Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Where might Miracle-san be?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Sorry, over here!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late, I was talking with the 
teacher.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what what what what, what's that 
supposed to mean!? You two had plans 
together!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Ruby is going to accompany me for my 
rehab.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yes~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Miracle!!!! Isn't that totally 
unfair?! You didn't say a single word to 
me?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! R-Right, of course... Sorry. I wasn't 
being considerate at all...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sounds good!! I'll tag along too☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doing rehab on the sly is so not fair! You 
gotta invite me to stuff like that too☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna blast some hype beats! It's way 
more fun that way, right!?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I wanna be with Ojo too, y'know☆ Right~~?♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Either is fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~, salt is the best after all!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, let us join in too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's super motivated right now, coming 
up with all kinds of menus.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sweet☆ Let's all do some mirror hype, 
then!
choice_data_list: Everyone's such good friends, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I love it too! I wuv all of you guys☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, and that goes for my classmate 
Trainypoyo too♪
choice_data_list:
The conversation is already moving 
forward?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my lively days spending time 
as Daitaku Helios's Trainer... are set to 
continue for a while yet.
